cohort_definition.FIRST_ENTRY: wallet had no prior qualified buy of this symbol before the entry
cohort_definition.REPEAT_ENTRY: wallet had at least one prior qualified buy of this symbol before the entry

methodology.entry: provider-labelled GMGN buy >= $5K with valid entry price
methodology.cohort_as_of_rule: prior_qualified_buys counts only rows with 0 < timestamp < entry_timestamp, so the cohort label is fixed before the measured window opens
methodology.rejected_design: a symbol-level 'has a long-term profile' split was rejected as near-useless: 94% of observations land in that cohort because the replay population is built from the same wallets that generate wallet_signal_profiles.json
methodology.interpretation: observational evidence, not realized exchange PnL
